messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD#23456 — capacity_queue_surge. Queue depth (inference-requests) exceeded 2500 for 5m. Affected route: /v1/generate. See: https://grafana.redwood.example.com/d/queues/queue-depth?panelId=4
PagerDuty: Incident PD#23456 created and routed to infra-oncall. Escalation policy: autoscale-critical -> infra-senior.
Samir Patel: acked — on it. initial triage: checking autoscaler/controller logs and recent deploys.
Jia Chen: seeing elevated tail latency on hosted-west, also p95 token latency spiking. Any recent model rollouts?
Samir Patel: no model rollouts in last 30m. autoscaler logs show repeated failures to provision nodes: "quota exceeded" and "rate limit" from cloud provider. attaching kubectl output.
Samir Patel: ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/scale-controller -c controller --since=20m
E0329 15:12:31.123 scale-controller  failed to create node: quotaExceeded: Insufficient resource quota for project
E0329 15:12:32.456 scale-controller  requeueing request after backoff
E0329 15:14:00.789 scale-controller  backoff exceeded, scaling stalled
```
Miguel Torres: confirmed — cloud account hit regional vCPU quota. We tried burst in us-west-2 earlier and provider rejected new instances.
Alice Rivera: customer-impact estimate? Are requests erroring or just queued?
Samir Patel: primarily queued. Some requests timing out (504) when wait > 30s. From logs: ~3% error rate on the route, affected customers: 18 tenants with high throughput.
Jia Chen: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily throttle non-critical background inference traffic (batch jobs) 2) manual surge: request quota increase (takes time) 3) failover traffic to dedicated nodes in eu-west for smaller subset 4) bump HPA min replicas for critical pods if node capacity available.
Samir Patel: started throttling batch jobs via config flag: `feature.batch_inference=false` — pushed via config service (changeid cfg-20270329-01).
Samir Patel: initiated cloud support request for quota increase (case #CS-9876). ETA unknown.
Miguel Torres: while quota is pending, I'm spinning up emergency on-demand instances in eu-west and us-east using secondary account with available quota. Command run: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inference-pool-east --desired-capacity 48`
Miguel Torres: also adding temporary node-pools in k8s with taints for burst-only workloads to avoid eviction of stable pools.
Samir Patel: manually adjusted scale-controller override to allow 48 nodes for up to 30m: `kubectl apply -f scale-override.yaml` — details in ops-runbook gist.
Jia Chen: routing changes applied: 20% of hotpath traffic shifted to eu-west via smart-routing policy to reduce queue on us-west. Monitor: traffic-reroute job  started.
Alice Rivera: posting incident status to #customers-ops with short note. Draft: "We are experiencing degraded inference throughput in us-west due to capacity constraints. We have applied temporary throttles and traffic rerouting; some requests may see higher latency or timeouts. We will update in 30 minutes."
PagerDuty: Pager acknowledged by Samir Patel at 2027-03-29T15:15:12Z.
Samir Patel: update: queue depth reduced from 2700 -> 900 in 18m after throttles + reroute + emergency nodes. Error rate down to 0.6%. Still monitoring backlog drain rate ~120 r/s.
Miguel Torres: note: cloud provider returned 16 additional vCPUs in us-west from quota request, but not enough to cover peak. We'll keep eu-west surge running until backlog < 200 and sustained.
Jia Chen: telemetry snippet: ```metrics: queue_depth: 900 -> 210 over 40m
p95_latency_route: 1.8s -> 600ms
errors_503: 72 -> 4
```
Samir Patel: I'm going to hand off active monitoring in 45m to Miguel (second-shift). tagging @oncall-rotation. Miguel — please take the hotpath watch.
Miguel Torres: taking over. I'll keep the emergency node pool until end of shift or until backlog < 100 for 30m. Will also follow up on quota ticket and request permanent quota bump.
Alice Rivera: customer impact summary for postmortem draft: "Intermittent request queuing and increased latency affecting ~18 tenants and short-lived 5xx errors for 3 tenants. Root cause: regional vCPU quota exhaustion causing autoscaler to fail. Mitigations: batch throttling, traffic failover to other regions, emergency on-demand nodes, HPA override. Next steps: automate cross-region failover playbook, add alert cooldown / annotation to avoid noisy re-firing, and request quota increase for prod accounts."
Samir Patel: agreed. I'll open the postmortem and assign owners: quota action -> Miguel, alert tuning -> Jia, playbook -> Alice.
PagerDuty: Incident PD#23456 status changed to "under investigation".
incident-bot: log entry created: incidents/PD-23456/20270329-1530 — tags: autoscaling, quota, queue.
Miguel Torres: small note — re: alert tuning, current threshold is 2000 queue depth with 3m window. We should add a second-tier warning at 1200 and a cooldown of 10m to prevent oscillation.
Jia Chen: will add alert proposal in alerts repo: increase eval window, add sustained slope detection (tokens/min).
Samir Patel: thanks all — leaving channel open for one more hour for final checks. Will mark resolved after backlog stable and metrics normal for 30m.
Miguel Torres: copied summary into #postmortems-drafts. I'll update the quota ticket and follow up with cloud support.
Alice Rivera: thanks team. :clap:
PagerDuty: PD#23456 acknowledged by Miguel Torres at 2027-03-29T16:02:10Z (escalated: infra-senior).
incident-bot: thread closed for new automated paging updates (manual continue allowed).
